text: シーギャロップに　のって　ここまで　きたのか？

structure.jp: シーギャロップに　のって
ここまで　きたのか？
structure.en: did you come all the way here?

patterns.name: 〜て (how)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here tells you in what way the next action is done. シーギャロップに　のって　きた = 'came by riding the Seagallop'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end asks for an explanation, in a plain manly tone: 'is it that...?'. きたのか = 'so you came, did you?'
